bullets.text: Israel has rejected a 15-point plan for Gaza proposed by Donald Trump, with Prime Minister Netanyahu stating the military will not withdraw until Hamas is disarmed.
A massive outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be mutating, as cases surpass 4,000 and health officials plan to go door-to-door to find patients.
The US State Department is set to close five foreign consulates and missions in Canada, Grenada, Japan, Indonesia, and Cameroon.

Queensland Deputy Premier Jarrod Bleijie is under scrutiny for personally approving town planning changes that promote house development in an area where landowners included a developer who had recently donated $50,000 for a private event.
The most dysfunctional emergency departments in Victoria are located in regional areas, with doctors reporting overcrowded corridors, patient safety lapses, and burnt-out staff.
An investigation is underway after a woman's body was discovered inside a suitcase near Oallen in the NSW Southern Highlands.

Investors are showing renewed interest in European stocks, with companies in the Stoxx Europe 600 projected to achieve a 22% increase in profits for the second quarter, easing concerns about global tensions.
Upcoming inflation data is crucial for the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions, as another firm reading could keep a September rate hike on the table.

China is emerging as a significant force in the global oil market, with its influence potentially surpassing that of OPEC, while African countries are increasingly favoring the yuan and local currencies over the dollar.
